title: Road-transport strike call for 1–3 March lifted before it took effect
reason: Contemporary search-result records say the unions lifted/suspended the strike order before the planned 1 March start, following talks with the minister. No executed March strike or public protest gathering is established.
notes: Search-only records; this is a nonoccurrence exclusion for the planned action, not a statement that transport grievances were absent.

title: Oil and gas upstream sector work stoppage
reason: KOACI body reports an open-ended workplace strike over labor conditions and legal entitlements but describes negotiations and work stoppage, not a public gathering, march or picket. Under the codebook, workplace negotiations/stoppages alone are not protest events.
notes: No public action is inferred from the labor dispute; if a public picket or march is documented elsewhere, it would require separate event screening.

title: PPA-CI party procession / Fête de la Renaissance in Yopougon
reason: An actual large procession is reported, but the body links it to a PPA-CI party festival, a message by the party leader and upcoming local elections. Political rallies associated with party positions/elections are excluded by the project codebook; the article supplies no separate state-policy demand.
notes: KOACI body says ‘plusieurs milliers’; those attendees are not transferred to another event. Preserve as observed exclusion rather than counting it as anti-state protest.

title: Le Monde report of a Thursday 7 March demonstration supporting Abidjan eviction victims (likely 2024; outside assigned quarter)
reason: Reclassified from v1_0001 E001 after checking the already-saved Le Monde body: the story was published 15 March 2024, describes February demolitions in Abidjan, and places the demonstration on Thursday 7 March. 7 March 2024 was Thursday; 7 March 2023 was Tuesday. The reported action therefore most likely belongs to 2024 and is out of this 2023-03 unit. No distinct saved 2023 evidence supports retaining it as a 2023 event.
notes: Data-only out-of-quarter reclassification based solely on saved S003 body, line 332. This record does not create or code a 2024 unit/event and does not assert a verified 2024 date beyond the likely-year inference.
